notes: Formal original-to-Harbor parity has not been run. The deterministic 47-pair sample covering all 42 environments is a development coverage slice. The proposed pilot uses four complete pairs, then expands to a maintainer-approved pair-complete 5–10% parity subset. The same pair IDs will run on both sides with a maintainer-approved lower-cost agent/model, at least two independent runs per side, and no offline stub. Paired accuracy and CAR will be aggregated by pair_id, with means, sample SEM, and MSE between original and Harbor score vectors. The maintainer-approved MSE threshold determines review readiness. Raw submissions, logs, and grading results will be retained with the dataset and parity links. Exact agent/model settings, judge endpoint, and parity key remain pending maintainer confirmation. Current evidence covers full generation, separate-verifier Docker builds, Oracle smoke, and the latest Harbor verifier checks. The offline judge stub is excluded from parity claims.
